premises.name: nested_call_admission
premises.statement: a dereference of this call's result is read only where the gateway's nested-call admission holds at the call site (premises N1-N10 of cards O04-TRACE and CONSTRUCTOR-RESIDUALS, checked per site): the call is the statement's only nested call and a whole argument of a contracted call at a declared Borrowed position modulo the dereference wrapper (N4-D), its written arity is this declaration's, and the unit's own declaration of the callee returns exactly one pointer level over a scalar type (N10); under them the argument binds, releases, escapes and addresses nothing the projection tracks

premises.name: cjson_allocator_hooks
premises.statement: hooks->allocate returns a fresh allocation or NULL, which cJSON_Delete releases through the matching deallocate hook: malloc and free in global_hooks (cJSON.c:178, :186) unless cJSON_InitHooks installed a user pair, a premise of whoever installed it; nothing is stated about the hooks changing between the allocation and its release

constructed_states.meaning: the run's stability of every member a constructor's stated result state names (rules 12o, 13w, 14e): every store into the member in every analysed unit is classified (a store into an object its function obtained from an owned-result call only or an automatic object, a null pointer into a function-pointer member, a constant flag-or, a case-guarded rewrite); anything else, a whole-object write of the record, or a unit that recorded no facts (premise P-OPCTOR-STORES-SEEN) leaves it not kept. `demoted` lists the Safe or Pending rows resting on a constructor whose stated member the run does not keep, now Unknown (constructed-state-open). Evidence and a demotion only: no row is promoted
